description: (Na)₂InGaF₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a InGaF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the InGaF₆ framework, In is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form InF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All In-F bond lengths are 2.11 Å. Ga is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form GaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent InF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ga-F bond lengths are 2.37 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one In and one Ga atom.
